notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax beyond the first {4}, if applicable.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Palinchron.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate The Master by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.
